# Apfel Park - Smartphone & Tech Shop Hamburg

> Apfel Park is a certified smartphone sales, trade-in, and repair center in Hamburg-Wilhelmsburg, Germany. We offer new, open-box, and refurbished iPhones, smartphones, laptops, tablets, gaming consoles, and accessories with a 12-month warranty.

## Business Details
- **Name**: Apfel Park
- **Address**: Wilhelm-Strauß-Weg 2b, 21109 Hamburg, Germany
- **Phone**: +49 40 58978787
- **Email**: info@apfel-park.de
- **Opening Hours**: Monday – Saturday, 09:30 – 20:00
- **Website**: https://apfel-park.de

## Core Services & Products
- **Smartphones & iPhones**: New, Open-Box, and Certified Pre-Owned iPhones (iPhone 11 to iPhone 17 series), Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, Xiaomi.
- **Tablets & iPads**: Apple iPads, Samsung Galaxy Tabs.
- **Laptops & MacBooks**: MacBooks and Windows laptops.
- **Accessories**: Protective cases, tempered glass screen protectors, fast chargers, cables, headphones, power banks, and SD cards.
- **Console Repair**: Professional HDMI port replacement, disc drive repair, thermal paste renewal, fan cleaning, and controller repair for PS4, PS5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.
- **Smartphone Repair**: Instant screen repair, battery replacement, water damage repair, and camera repair.
- **Trade-In / Ankauf**: Fair cash valuation and instant payout or trade-in credit for used devices.

## Key Policies
- **Warranty**: 12-month warranty included on all certified devices.
- **Condition Grading**: Clear labeling on every product (New, Open-Box, Used) with battery health transparency.
- **Shipping & Returns**: Insured shipping within Germany (1-3 business days) or free in-store pickup in Hamburg. 14-day statutory right of withdrawal.
